descriptionByLocale.en:
Do you have a strong trading / technology / analytical background with in-depth knowledge of equity markets and market micro-structure?
UBS is looking for an Electronic Agency Algorithmic Trader to:

• manage the quantitative parameters that drive the overall algorithmic behavior
• provide daily interaction with the equity trading desks, quantitative analysts, and clients to adjust parameters on the back of stock specific news and in advance of special event days to ensure algorithm behavior is aligned with client and market expectations
• apply client specific configuration that enhance client/algorithm specific behavior, manage and prioritize product enhancements, risk management, and conduct data driven analysis to automate and optimize the trading platform and workflows
• manage releases and custom algorithm solutions and provide Real Time management of trading risk and intraday monitoring of the algorithms across all business types, products, and clients
• be responsible for direct interaction with the developers and quantitative analysts surrounding improvement to the algorithmic products including analytics and research
• interact with execution consultants who work directly with external clients to optimize and improve trading experience with UBS
• act as an electronic trading subject matter expertise with ability to serve as real time source of information to users of electronic trading product both internally & externally
